summary: End-to-end testing of API Keys management feature (admin CRUD + 3rd-party scanner endpoints + admin UI). 17/17 backend pytest cases pass and full frontend Playwright flow succeeds. All 13 user-listed acceptance items verified.

minor.issue: valid_for not validated on update — silently dropped if value invalid; only label/valid_for/is_active accepted but no 422 if all values invalid (returns 400 'Güncellenecek alan yok'). Acceptable but inconsistent vs POST.

issues: Sidebar entry uses emoji '🔑' inline with the Lucide Shield icon — visually duplicates the icon in the active row (key emoji + shield rendering side-by-side). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: tighten PUT /api/admin/api-keys/{id} validation to return 422 when valid_for is not in {summit,fair,both}
Optional: drop the 🔑 emoji from the sidebar label since the Shield icon already renders alongside it (AdminLayout.jsx line 13)
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is 2757 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Should be split into routers (auth, admin, public, external, registration).

External /external/checkin returns HTTP 200 with status='not_found' on scope mismatch instead of 403; may hide auth/scope errors from monitoring tools but matches admin /checkin behaviour, so consistent.

_validate_api_key increments usage_count BEFORE business logic — counts also increment for 'not_found' / 'not_verified' / scope-mismatch results. May skew analytics. Consider only increment on successful badge match.

ApiKeysManagement.jsx renders the full key (data.key) even on the listing endpoint — anyone with admin access can re-read every key forever. If desired, the spec note 'Anahtar yalnızca bir kez gösterilir' is not actually enforced.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ guests (one fair visit_type, one summit visit_type, both is_verified=true) inserted directly into MongoDB collection guests via pymongo session fixture and removed in teardown. Test API keys created via API are tracked and deleted in session-scoped fixture teardown — no leftover TEST_ rows remain after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_api_keys.py covers all API-keys CRUD + external scanner flows (17 tests, all passing). Uses pymongo to seed/cleanup verified guests directly because POST /api/register/guest does not return verification token. Reuse this fixture pattern for any future external-endpoint tests. Frontend page is at /admin/api-anahtarlari with data-testid: api-keys-page, btn-toggle-docs, btn-new-api-key, api-key-form, form-label, form-valid-for, form-submit, api-docs, api-key-display-{id}, copy-key-{id}, toggle-{id}, delete-{id}.
rca of the issue: No issues found requiring RCA — feature works end-to-end.
